submitted.rationale: Near-1:1 Ag:Sb composition. XRD shows a mix of AgSbO3 pyrochlore (Q ≈ 2.13, 2.46) and Ag-metal/secondary peaks. It had the highest measured EQE at 2.7 eV (0.867%), above index 7 (0.588%, more Ag-rich) and index 14 (0.265%, mostly pyrochlore). This suggests the maximum is close to Ag0.5Sb0.5.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.588%, lower than index 9. It is more Ag-rich, and at index 4 the pyrochlore peaks are gone.
Measured EQE 0.265%. XRD is dominated by the AgSbO3 pyrochlore, yet EQE is low.
Not merit-measured. XRD looks like index 14 (pyrochlore-rich), so EQE is likely similarly low.
